name: State-Space Routing Disguise
description: Replaces the algebraic inequality check (which models memorize as 3-coloring) with a functional rule about a 3-state unidirectional ring. Models that surface-match will simulate the ring and likely TLE or mismodel the constraints, while models that reason will deduce that a 1- or 2-step path on a 3-node ring is simply a disguised inequality ($s_u \neq s_v$) and use the efficient backtracking approach.
